summary: Tested three targeted fixes: (1) TON Connect manifest v6 + icon v3 with GET/HEAD support and CORS; (2) TonIslandPage owner-avatar SmartAvatar rendering (no [object Object] broken img); (3) zero-locked buy button replacing Buy for users with Level-0 business. All 11 backend tests pass. All 3 frontend UI checks pass.
critical_code_review_comments: TonIslandPage.jsx is 2196 lines — should be split into smaller components per <file_size> guideline (info panel, buy actions, cell handlers).

presale_gate fires before zero_business gate on backend; frontend prioritizes zero-locked-buy over presale-locked-buy correctly. Ordering is consistent with the requested UX but note backend will return presale_locked (not zero_locked) when presale is empty — this is fine because zero_locked test requires an active presale allowlist for the cell.
seed_data_creation: Backend test_zero_locked_returns_423 temporarily seeds admin_settings.presale (active=true, selected_plots=[target cell]) then restores previous document in finally block.
context_for_next_testing_agent: TonIslandPage exposes window.__handleCellClick({x,y}) — use it to open the info panel programmatically instead of trying to click the isometric canvas. Login via API + localStorage.setItem('token', <jwt>) works to skip the login UI. Backend presale gate blocks non-admins by default (no active presale doc), so to reach the zero_locked path, seed admin_settings.presale with active=true and the target cell.
verified_scenarios: POST /api/island/buy/{x}/{y} for testuser on presale-allowed cell → 423 code=zero_locked
Admin cell [12,25] info panel: SmartAvatar renders data-testid='smart-avatar-img' (or would fall back to initials 'S' on error); no img src contains [object Object]; username 'SanyaNazarov' visible
Admin free cell [12,26]: data-testid='buy-plot-btn' present, zero-locked-buy absent (no regression)
testuser@example.com free cell [12,26]: data-testid='zero-locked-buy' present and disabled; data-testid='buy-plot-btn' absent
